verdict.rationale: FFmpeg exposes a C library API (libav*) and a CLI, so a machine-readable description of that API is a fair ask. However, the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The nightly Doxygen documentation is human-oriented reference material, not a machine-readable spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
